fullExplanation.text: Understanding 1 Chronicles in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life

1 Chronicles provides the larger frame for 1 Chronicles in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life. An independent Catholic study of 1 Chronicles focused on genealogy, David, worship, priesthood, and temple preparation.
